mapper.sql: p.id, p.author_id AS authorId, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.title, p.summary, p.content, p.cover_url AS coverUrl, p.visibility, p.status, p.reject_reason AS rejectReason, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, p.is_top AS isTop, p.is_featured AS isFeatured, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.submitted_at AS submittedAt, p.published_at AS publishedAt, m.name AS authorName, m.username AS authorUsername, m.identity AS authorIdentity, m.pictureUrl AS authorAvatar, c.name AS categoryName, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY t.name SEPARATOR ',') FROM forum_post_tag pt INNER JOIN forum_tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE pt.post_id = p.id AND t.status = 1 ) AS tagNames
mapper.select: SELECT FROM forum_post p INNER JOIN member m ON m.id = p.author_id LEFT JOIN forum_category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.description, c.sort_order AS sortOrder, COUNT(p.id) AS postCount FROM forum_category c LEFT JOIN forum_post p ON p.category_id = c.id AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE c.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.description, c.sort_order ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT m.id, m.name, m.identity, m.pictureUrl AS avatar, COUNT(p.id) AS postCount FROM forum_post p INNER JOIN member m ON m.id = p.author_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.identity, m.pictureUrl ORDER BY postCount DESC, m.id ASC LIMIT 6
